content: Adenike Eketunde is a medical professional with a diverse background in education, clinical experience, certifications, research, and presentations. Below is a detailed account of her qualifications and contributions: Authored Pages She has authored medical content on topics such as choledocholithiasis, peliosis hepatis, and vomiting in children. Education She completed her foundational studies in Basic Science at Igbinedion University from 2011 to 2013. She earned her Doctor of Medicine degree from Windsor University School of Medicine, located in Cayon, Saint Kitts and Nevis, between 2013 and 2017. She pursued a Master’s degree in Public Health at the University of Massachusetts, Lowell, from 2018 to 2020. Clinical Experience She worked as a Pathology Assistant at SiParadigm from October 2020 to December 2020. She completed her core and elective clerkships at Joseph N. France General Hospital in Brumaire, Saint Kitts and Nevis, from July 2015 to August 2017. She undertook a clinical externship at Vascular and Vein Associates in Methuen, Massachusetts, USA, from March 2019 to August 2019. Licenses and Certifications She holds certifications in CPR and AED. She is certified in Basic Life Support (BLS) for Healthcare Providers. She has completed training in Bloodborne Pathogens and COVID-19 Contact Tracing through Johns Hopkins via Coursera. She has received certificates of participation in various specialized areas, including: The AJCP/Lab Medicine COVID-19 Series. An overview of Immuno-Oncology. Molecular Testing for Colorectal Cancer. She is certified in HIPAA compliance and harassment prevention. She has completed online training in protecting human research participants. She earned a Certificate of Achievement in improving global health through HarvardX. She is a Certified Clinical Research Professional. Dissertations She authored a dissertation titled A Review of the Indications, Techniques, and Complications of Male Urethral Catheterization for General Medical Practice, published on September 24, 2020. She conducted a review of postmortem findings in patients with COVID-19, published on August 27, 2020. She explored the topic Diabetes as a Risk Factor for Breast Cancer, published on May 7, 2020. Presentations She served as the lead presenter on the topic Impact of Social Media on Health Promotion in Sub-Saharan Africa at the 22nd Annual Student Research and Community Engagement Symposium held at the University of Massachusetts, Lowell, USA.
